titleEn: Caotaibanzi (草台班子): 'The World Is a Makeshift Troupe' — China's Reassuring Nihilism
summaryEn: A caotai banzi was a makeshift theater troupe. In 2024 the phrase went viral as 'the world is one big makeshift troupe' — the realization we're all improvising.
emotionEquivalent: 草台戏班子 / 大家都是草台
emotionEquivalentEn: amateur hour / everyone is winging it

symbolLayer.literalTranslation: 临时搭起来的戏台班子
symbolLayer.explanation: 传统戏曲行业词汇的隐喻化：把世界比作临时搭台的草台戏，谁都别装专业
symbolLayer.explanationEn: A metaphor from traditional opera: the world as a hastily built stage troupe — no one is as professional as they pretend.

origin: 本为戏曲史术语（民国乡间流动戏班），2023-2024 年以「世界是一个巨大的草台班子」句式刷屏，入选《语言文字周报》2024 十大网络流行语
originEn: Originally an opera-history term (roving rural troupes in the Republican era); the 2023-2024 phrase 'the world is one big makeshift troupe' went viral and made the 2024 top-ten list.
usage: 两种语气：① 安慰剂（「大家都是草台班子，别慌」）② 犬儒（「这行业就是草台班子」）；常与「祛魅」连用
usageEn: Two tones: a comfort ('everyone is a makeshift troupe, relax') or cynicism ('this industry is a makeshift troupe'); often paired with 'disenchantment'.
commonMisreading: 不是纯粹的贬义吐槽；它的流行恰恰因为它是「安慰性犬儒」——用揭穿权威的方式缓解焦虑
commonMisreadingEn: Not just derogatory snark; it went viral because it's 'comforting cynicism' — relieving anxiety by debunking authority.
